channels.name: Nurse Vickie
channels.description: Nurse Vickie — home care business coach and mentor, CEO/Founder of Petra Home Care (Houston, TX). Channel exists specifically to educate home care owners and operators on running the business, not just clinical care.
channels.verificationMethod: Found via a broader search beyond the founder's original candidates (the 'Homecare Series' video lead didn't resolve to an identifiable channel). The search result returned the channel URL directly with its full About-section description, confirming it's real, dedicated, and on-topic — exactly the kind of channel the founder's own research was looking for but hadn't surfaced yet.

blogs.name: NurseJournal.org
blogs.verificationMethod: NurseJournal.org independently confirmed real, well-established, editorially-reviewed (About Us page: fact-checked, nursing-professional-reviewed content). Listed as having an RSS feed across two separate FeedSpot directories, but the exact feed path shown was 'nursejournal.org/resources' / 'nursejournal.org/articles' rather than a clean /feed suffix — LOWER confidence than most other entries this session, worth a direct check before shipping.

books.title: Handbook on Entrepreneurial Practice: Nurses Creating Opportunities
books.author: International Council of Nurses (ICN)
books.freeSourceNote: Free direct PDF from the International Council of Nurses' own site, no signup required
books.verificationMethod: Hosted directly on icn.ch, the official global nursing body — confirmed real, free, no paywall or account needed. More institutionally credible than most of the commercial titles the founder's research found (all paid, none Nigeria/Africa-specific).

notes: Honest finding, matching the founder's own curriculum research: no Nigeria, Africa, or global 'business of nursing' YouTube channel surfaced this round — the strongest lead ('Homecare Series' on YouTube) could not be traced to an identifiable, verifiable channel. Left at 0 rather than forcing a weak match. Worth a dedicated re-attempt later with different search terms rather than treated as permanently empty.
